about_the_game:
Discover the Digital Deluxe Edition of “Space Adventure Cobra: The Awakening” and enjoy its faithful original soundtrack along with exclusive behind-the-scenes production content, offering insight into creative process behind the game development. This edition also includes a bonus mission adapted from the 13th episode of the anime series: “The Roulette of Death”.

This special edition includes:
  • Artbook
  • Original Soundtrack
  • Smoking Skin
  • Bonus Mission
